title: John 9

verified.text: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
His disciples asked him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"
Jesus answered, "This man didn't sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
While I am in the world, I am the light of the world."

verify_note: Verses 1 to 5 were checked against three WEB pages on 2026-11-06. In verse 3 the older WEB edition has different wording. Verses 6 to 41: the wording is not stored yet. Open the link and read the verse yourself.

scenes.title: A man who was blind from birth
lines: Teacher: Jesus passes by. He sees a man.
Teacher: The man is blind. He was blind from birth.
Teacher: From birth means: from the first day of his life.

scenes.title: The question
lines: Teacher: The disciples ask a question. They want to know why the man is blind.
Teacher: Jesus answers. The blindness is not a punishment.
Teacher: Jesus says, "I am the light of the world."

scenes.title: Mud and the pool
lines: Teacher: Jesus makes mud. He puts it on the man's eyes.
Teacher: He tells the man to go and wash in the pool of Siloam.
Teacher: The man goes. He washes. Now he can see.

scenes.title: The neighbors ask
lines: Teacher: The neighbors see the man. They are not sure.
Teacher: Some say, "It is the same man." Some say, "No, it is a different man."
Teacher: The man says, "I am the man."

scenes.title: The Pharisees ask
lines: Teacher: It was the Sabbath when Jesus healed him.
Teacher: The Pharisees ask the man many questions.
Teacher: They do not agree with each other. Some are against Jesus. Some ask, "How can a bad man do this?"

scenes.title: The parents
lines: Teacher: The leaders call the man's parents.
Teacher: The parents say, "He is our son. He was born blind."
Teacher: They do not say more. They are afraid of the leaders. They say, "He is old enough. Ask him."

scenes.title: The man speaks
lines: Teacher: The leaders call the man again. They are angry.
Teacher: The man is not afraid. He tells them what he knows.
Teacher: He says he was blind and now he sees. The leaders send him away.

scenes.title: The man believes
lines: Teacher: Jesus finds the man again.
Teacher: Jesus talks with him.
Teacher: The man believes in Jesus.
